name: Tianjin Hi-Tech Development Co.,Ltd.
summary: Established in Tianjin, China, in 2001, Tianjin Hi-Tech Development Co.,Ltd. primarily focuses on the creation, management, and industrial funding of high-technology zone infrastructure across China. The company also extends its activities to include developing specialized business parks, investing in high-tech enterprises, providing startup incubation services, engaging in commercial trade, and managing other diverse ventures.
